findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-sds" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sheets_due_for_review · Private data: list_my_chemicals, sheets_due_for_review, ppe_for_chemical, hazards_for_chemical · Public sink: find_sds_for_inventory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sheets_due_for_review · Private data: list_my_chemicals, sheets_due_for_review, ppe_for_chemical, hazards_for_chemical · Public sink: find_sds_for_inventory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_safety_data_sheet" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
